_comment: Canonical registry of harnesses wired into this stack. Machine-readable companion to README.md. Every harness here has been verified end-to-end by verify-harnesses.sh, not merely installed.

backend.note: Slot roster lives ONLY here. Every harness config is derived from it by sync-harnesses.sh. Never hand-edit a harness's model list. Path moved from E:\AI\config during the 2026-09-09 D-drive consolidation.

harnesses.name: Prime Agent
harnesses.role: Capability-amplification candidate. Persistent IPython REPL, recursive subagents, and a Continual Harness that carries memory/skills across trajectories. The ARC-AGI-3 95.5% harness.
harnesses.notes: Was already installed before this integration. Its config had drifted badly -- it still described `deep` as Nemotron (deleted days earlier) and listed a `deep-lite` slot that no longer existed. sync-harnesses.sh now regenerates it.

harnesses.name: DeepSeek Harness
harnesses.modelSelection: config file only -- no --model flag; set by set-harness-model.sh
harnesses.role: DeepSeek's own agent loop. Verbose interleaved reasoning on stdout rather than a structured event stream.
harnesses.notes: Must be installed from the PUBLISHED npm package. Running the repo from source is a dead end: @deepseek-ai/cordis declares FiberState as `export const enum`, which TypeScript erases at compile time, leaving no runtime export for tsx's isolated transpilation to import. pnpm run build only builds apps/web, build:lib does not fix it, rescope-vendor runs dry-only, and node_modules/@deepseek-ai/cordis never existed. The published build has the const enums inlined.

harnesses.name: OpenClaw
harnesses.role: Chat-platform-first agent with an isolated headless exec mode.
harnesses.notes: Two traps. (1) `openclaw agent --local` ignores cwd entirely and edits ~/.openclaw/workspace; a run configured that way reported "Fixed and committed" while the trajectory's file was untouched. Use `agent exec --cwd`, which sets both the agent workspace and the tool working directory. Do not try to stage into the shared workspace instead: OpenClaw attests it in state/openclaw.sqlite and refuses to run once BOOTSTRAP.md has gone missing. (2) The full tool surface builds a 33,635-token system prompt that does not fit deep-tiel's 32,768 context. --local-model-lean, OpenClaw's own reduced surface for local models, fits and makes both deep slots usable -- an earlier note in this file claiming deep-tiel was impossible was wrong.

harnesses.name: Hermes Agent
harnesses.role: Standing personal-assistant daemon with persistent cross-session memory, evaluated here purely as a coding harness.
harnesses.notes: Its tools resolve relative paths against $HOME -- not the process working directory, and not --in, which it accepts and then ignores. From a /mnt/d work dir it "fixed" ~/.openclaw/workspace/pkg/alias.py, another harness's leftover copy of the same fixture; with --no-restore-cwd it looked for /home/priya/pkg/alias.py and created the directory; from /tmp it edited a stale copy still under $HOME; once that copy was deleted it found nothing. Overriding HOME to the work directory, with HERMES_HOME pinned so its config and session store stay put, makes it edit the right file every time, drvfs included. --yolo is required or the approval prompts block a headless run. Installed with --skip-browser --skip-computer-use (Playwright pulls ~500 MB of Chromium no fixture task can use); bundled skills kept.
harnesses.notWiredPreviously: This harness was recorded here as "deliberately not wired" on the strength of its documentation alone -- no ACP, daemon-shaped, memory already covered by funes. That call was made without running it and was overridden.

removed.criterion: Removed for failing more than one task category, or for being unable to run a whole model slot. Single-trajectory misses were treated as noise and did not disqualify a harness.

harnesses.name: Pi
harnesses.why: rollback 2/3 and dedupe 1/3 on fast (21/24, last in the field), plus the worst tail measured anywhere in the campaign -- one deep-tiel trajectory ran 9163.9s, 67x the next worst maximum. Was this project's original daily driver and the harness the 8-task protocol was built around.

harnesses.name: OpenCode
harnesses.why: the only harness to fail two categories on one slot (rollback 2/3, cache 2/3 on fast) AND a third on the other (pipeline 2/3 on deep-tiel); additionally acquired a reproducible ~300s startup hang partway through the campaign that was never root-caused.

harnesses.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
harnesses.why: cannot use the fast slot at all -- Qwen3.5's chat template rejects its `instructions` field. Perfect 24/24 on deep-tiel, but a harness that structurally covers only half the roster is not worth maintaining when four others cover both.

removed.note: Removal was a full uninstall: npm packages, config and state directories, and Zed agent_servers entries. The Codex OAuth token was preserved at config/removed-harness-auth/ because it is the only artefact here that cannot be regenerated locally. Results for all three are retained in harnesses/results/ and HARNESSES.md -- the measurements stand as a record even though the harnesses are gone.
